title: LOOP_V1 frontier-call ledger row
description: One row of run_state/frontier_calls.jsonl, appended by agent_wrapper.frontier_cli.invoke_frontier BEFORE every return (real, mock, and every error path). The writer is the source of truth for this shape: it always writes the eight required fields, with verdict always null at that layer (the review layer owns verdicts). candidate_id and reasoning_digest are declared per LOOP_V1 P2 for the review layer's rows (the frontier-vs-local calibration join key and digest) but are OPTIONAL here because frontier_cli does not write them. Append-only ledger; rows are never edited.

timestamp.description: UTC ISO 8601 with trailing Z, e.g. 2026-08-14T12:00:00.000000Z.

cli_version.description: Output of `<cli> --version` (memoized per process); 'unknown' when the probe fails; 'mock' under MOCK_LLM.

role.description: Caller-declared role for the call, e.g. methods_reviewer / novelty_reviewer.

candidate_id.description: Join key vs the local (Qwen) vote fields for the frontier-vs-local calibration dataset (LOOP_V1 P2). Review-layer field; frontier_cli does not write it.

verdict.description: Always null at the frontier_cli layer -- the review layer owns verdicts.

reasoning_digest.description: Short digest of the reviewer's reasoning (LOOP_V1 P2). Review-layer field; frontier_cli does not write it.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock milliseconds for the call; 0 under MOCK_LLM.

exit_code.description: CLI process exit code; -1 on timeout, 127 on launch failure, 0 under MOCK_LLM.

prompt_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the exact prompt string (the prompt itself is never logged).
